text: あんたにも　ホントの　たたかいって　ものを　おしえて　やる！

structure.jp: ホントの　たたかいって　ものを
structure.en: the thing called a real battle

patterns.name: 〜というもの
patterns.span: たたかいって　もの
patterns.explanation: というもの after a word means 'the thing called X', pointing at what it really is. って is the spoken short form of という. たたかいって　もの = 'what a battle really is'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing it for someone, said from above and a little roughly. おしえて　やる = 'I'll teach you'.
